name: Request Shelf
overview: Request movies and TV seasons through Seerr.
description: Search Jellyfin for a title, request missing movies and seasons, and check download progress.

versions.changelog: Search Jellyfin normally to see playable titles followed by missing movies and shows. Request cards display Seerr download progress and refresh when reopened. Existing Jellyfin-to-Seerr account pairings carry over.
